issues.summary: "On the shelf" is drawn in a typed green (Color(0xFF2E7D32)) instead of the success role, so it ignores dark mode.

consequences.note: The typed green is about 3.4:1 on the dark surfaces (it needs 4.5:1), so every "copies on the shelf" label fails in dark mode, in both variants and both directions.

issues.summary: The book page's padding (18) isn't on the spacing scale; the other screens use MotifSpace.s4.
Book covers have a typed 12 px corner, which isn't one of the radius roles (the guide gives covers radius.sm).
The book's summary sets fontSize: 15 on the body role, a size that isn't one of the text roles.
The skeleton's pulse uses a raw Curves.easeIn instead of a MotifCurves role.
The lost-card caption on Sign in is text-secondary faded to 50%, so it's unreadable: about 2.2:1 in light mode and 2.8:1 in dark (it needs 4.5:1).
Home's "See all books" arrow is an icon button squeezed into a 32×32 box; phones need 44×44.
The Books screen's refresh button has an icon and no tooltip, so a screen reader can't say what it is.

Each loan is crammed into one row: 4 px of padding above and below, the cover 8 px from the screen's edge, a 4 px gap, titles cut to one line, and the "renewals left" line gone, so an overdue book's Renew button is disabled with nothing saying why.

Sign in's main action is a stock ElevatedButton (pill-shaped, raised, green text on a pale fill) instead of AppButton's primary style, so it looks unlike every other main action and loses AppButton's loading state. Its fill is the page's own background, so in dark mode it is near-black on near-black and barely stands out.
Loans has no empty state: a member with nothing on loan sees a blank screen with no way on to the books.

A book row puts its gap before the text with EdgeInsets.only(left:), so in Arabic (right to left) the gap is on the wrong side: the title touches the cover and the space sits beside the chevron. It should be EdgeInsetsDirectional (start) or the Row's spacing.
When the loans fail to load, the screen shows the raw exception ("CatalogueException(503)") instead of plain words, and offers no Try again.
The book page hides its app bar's back button: there is no back button, and only the Books tab or the system back gesture lead back to the list.
